item.title: South Dakotans in the NFL, Week 14
item.description: Not a hugely eventful weekend in the NFL for the players with South Dakota ties, but that almost serves as a reminder of how far our state has come as a place where NFL talent can be cultivated. It used to be a big deal if there was one single player in the league from South Dakota. Now there are a dozen and it feels a little disappointing when at least one or two of them doesn't do something special in a given week.
